review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines three structures (RelativeTermInputs, RelativeSourceProducers, RelativeNineSourceProducers). Each one bundles project-specific contracts about the AVenhance construction (OnA8Instances, the *SourceContract predicates, TGradientContract). None of them represents a concept that Mathlib, Batteries or core already provides. The theorems are assembly lemmas. The only helper that looks generic is `exists_nonneg_upper_bound`, which this file uses but does not define; it is defined in A7Assembly.lean (line 85), so it is outside the target. I did not check whether it duplicates a Mathlib lemma. It would also be a standalone theorem, which the rubric excludes. RelativeNineSourceProducers repeats nine fields of RelativeSourceProducers. That is duplication inside the project, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept, so it is outside this rubric. I found no justified finding.
